using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;
using MediaBrowser.MediaEncoding.Encoder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class EncoderValidatorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<EncoderValidator>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly ILogger<EncoderValidator> _logger;
    private readonly EncoderValidator _validator;

    public EncoderValidatorTests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<EncoderValidator>>();
        _logger = _loggerMock.Object;
        _validator = new EncoderValidator(_logger, "/path/to/ffmpeg");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullFilter_ReturnsFalse_NoLogWarning()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption(null, "option");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.VerifyLogWarningNotCalled();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyFilter_ReturnsFalse_NoLogWarning()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("", "option");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.VerifyLogWarningNotCalled();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullOption_ReturnsFalse_NoLogWarning()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("filter", null);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.VerifyLogWarningNotCalled();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyOption_ReturnsFalse_NoLogWarning()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("filter", "");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.VerifyLogWarningNotCalled();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_ValidFilterWithOptionAvailable_ReturnsTrue_NoLogWarning()
    {
        // Arrange
        var expectedOutput = "Filter testfilter\n    option";
        MockProcessOutput(expectedOutput);

        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("testfilter", "option");

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
        _loggerMock.VerifyLogWarningNotCalled();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_FilterNotFound_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Arrange
        var expectedOutput = "Some other output without 'Filter testfilter'";
        MockProcessOutput(expectedOutput);

        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("testfilter", "testoption");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            "Filter: {Name} with option {Option} is not available",
            "testfilter",
            "testoption"), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption_BsfNotFound_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Arrange
        var expectedOutput = "Some output without 'Bit stream filter testbsf'";
        MockProcessOutput(expectedOutput, isBitstream: true);

        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption("testbsf", "testoption");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            "Bit stream filter: {Name} with option {Option} is not available",
            "testbsf",
            "testoption"), Times.Once);
    }

    private void MockProcessOutput(string output, bool isBitstream = false)
    {
        // This would require making GetProcessOutput virtual or using a different approach
        // For this test focusing on logger calls, we test the paths that reach the LogWarning
        // without needing to mock the private method
    }
}

public static class MockExtensions
{
    public static void VerifyLogWarningNotCalled(this Mock<ILogger<EncoderValidator>> mock)
    {
        mock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<string>(),
            It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
    }
}

        public EncoderValidatorTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<EncoderValidator>>();
            Mock.Of<ILogger<EncoderValidator>> logger = _loggerMock.Object;
            _logger = logger;
            _validator = new EncoderValidator(_logger, "/path/to/ffmpeg");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullFilter_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Act
            var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption(null, "option");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyFilter_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Act
            var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("", "option");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullOption_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Act
            var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("filter", null);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyOption_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Act
            var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("filter", "");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_NonEmptyInputs_CallsLogWarning()
        {
            // Act
            var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("testfilter", "testoption");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Filter: {Name} with option {Option} is not available")),

                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
